title: 2026–2027 年度公費流感疫苗 10 月 1 日開打，新冠疫苗同步提供
summary: 2026–2027 年度公費流感疫苗 10 月 1 日開打，第一階段長者、幼兒、孕婦、高風險者與學生等；11 月 1 日開放 50–64 歲，新冠疫苗同步。
bodyMarkdown:
疾病管制署宣布，2026–2027 年度公費流感疫苗將於 **10 月 1 日**開打。第一階段對象包括 65 歲以上長者、55 歲以上原住民、6 個月以上至國小入學前幼兒、孕婦及 6 個月內嬰兒之父母、19–64 歲高風險對象、國小至高中職與五專一至三年級學生、醫事防疫人員及長照機構住民與工作人員等；**11 月 1 日**起開放 50–64 歲無高風險慢性病成人。

新年度新冠疫苗同日開打，6 個月以上民眾皆可接種，可與流感疫苗同時分開部位接種。接種地點請查詢「流感防治一網通」或疫苗接種地圖。

en.title: 2026–27 government-funded flu vaccination starts 1 October, with COVID-19 vaccine available at the same time
en.summary: Phase 1 covers older adults, young children, pregnant women, high-risk groups and students from 1 October; adults aged 50–64 from 1 November. COVID-19 vaccine is offered from the same day.
en.bodyMarkdown:
Taiwan CDC announced that government-funded flu vaccination for 2026–27 starts on **1 October**. Phase 1 covers adults 65+, indigenous people 55+, children from 6 months to school entry, pregnant women and parents of infants under 6 months, high-risk adults aged 19–64, primary to senior high school students, health and public health workers, and long-term care residents and staff. Adults aged 50–64 without high-risk conditions are eligible from **1 November**.

The new-season COVID-19 vaccine starts the same day for everyone aged 6 months and over and can be given together with the flu vaccine. Find a clinic via the influenza portal or the vaccination map.
